scope: Require every responsive Inspector registry property to expose a valid control, command, Page Model key, and Canvas/public renderer route.

renderer_routes.STYLE_MAP: shared by Canvas and public page renderer
renderer_routes.x: Canvas offset adapter maps to CSS left and promotes static nodes to relative
renderer_routes.y: Canvas offset adapter maps to CSS top and promotes static nodes to relative

additional_contracts: all responsive properties declare command and Page Model key

test.name: every responsive registry field has an explicit Inspector control and Canvas/public style route

acceptance: The registry route contract is automated; full 77.44.7.A and physical device/user acceptance remain OPEN.
